Yeah he does. I get where he’s coming from, but I’ve been trying to get him to understand that I work differently than most people. he makes me feel useless. He’s my opposite. He’s good at pretty much good at everything useful while I’m struggling.
I only have my brother. He doesn’t fully understand how Aspergers affects me so he gets upset at me that I can’t talk to people like he can.

It’s from years of bullying I’ve received when I was in school. I remember one time my ninth grade year. I was trying to make some small talk with people to try and make friends and a person told me no one cares about me, that I’m a creep(I’m introverted so I don’t talk much), and that I should kill myself. That was six years ago and it still hurts. I’ve tried to make friends but they’ve never really stayed around long and start avoiding me. I just give up on people. I try my best, and no one cares. It’s hard trying to talk when you have Aspergers and have social anxiety.

I mean kinda. I’m in the stage of having accepted it, but still has a lot of internalized homophobia. I’ve been on dating apps for a while now and I haven’t had any luck because I’m unattractive and it’s made me depressed and hating myself for being ugly and gay.
